messages.content: Hello! I'm KrishiVoice, your farming assistant. How can I help you today? You can tell me what crop you grow, ask about water, fertilizer, weather, or what to plant for profit.

Best crops for your Wetland land (Monsoon season (Jun–Oct)): 1. Banana — demand 10/10, profit potential 7/10. Price hint: ₹25-45/dozen. 2. Rice — demand 9/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: ₹22-28/kg, avg yield 4.2 t/ha. 3. Sugarcane — demand 9/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: Govt FRP ~₹3400/ton, avg yield 2.2 t/ha. 4. Maize — demand 8/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: ₹18-24/kg.
